chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a 21-year-old Moroccan man with short black hair and light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers
chars.SISTER: SISTER: a 17-year-old Moroccan girl with long dark curly hair in a high ponytail, wearing an oversized lilac sweatshirt and light blue jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the doorway of a teenage girl's bedroom in a Moroccan apartment (coastal city), NARRATOR leans over the bed and secretly snatches a phone with a glittery pink case from the pillow, glancing nervously over his shoulder toward the door, guilty excited face clearly visible, head-to-waist framing. 2D animated illustration, warm evening light. No text anywhere.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot: NARRATOR holds the glittery pink phone, the screen lights up and unlocks with no password, he raises his eyebrows in surprise, mouth half open. The screen is just a soft glow, no readable text or icons. 2D animated illustration. No text anywhere.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits on the edge of his sister's bed holding the pink phone, scratching his head, suspicious squinting face, thinking 'why no code?', the room has posters without text, a school bag and a mirror. 2D animated illustration. No text anywhere.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR scrolls quickly through chats on the pink phone with his thumb, bored relaxed face, leaning against the bedroom wall, phone screen only a green-tinted glow with blurred bubbles, no readable text. 2D animated illustration. No text anywhere.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR freezes, eyes wide, bringing the pink phone close to his face, the screen glow lighting his shocked face in the darker room, he has just found a hidden archived chat group. Screen content not readable. 2D animated illustration, dramatic lighting. No text anywhere.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Flashback: at night SISTER lies on her bed under a blanket typing fast on her glittery pink phone, grinning mischievously, face lit by the screen, her door closed. 2D animated illustration, cool night blue tones. No text anywhere.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR covers his mouth with one hand in disbelief, staring at the pink phone in his other hand, sitting on the floor of the sister's bedroom, comic stunned face. 2D animated illustration. No text anywhere.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR in the foreground stares at the pink phone with a worried frown, while behind him SISTER appears in the bedroom doorway holding a glass of water, not yet noticing him, tension. Both faces visible. 2D animated illustration. No text anywhere.
